independence: The reviewer did not implement these edits. The reviewer supplied an earlier visual audit, so this was not a blinded comparison or an observer study.
scope: Four README Create panels only, using matched before/after images at identical canvas and 720 px display width.

review_method.actual_images_opened: All four full-panel before PNGs, all four current candidate PNGs, and all four repository 720 px side-by-side comparison boards were opened with view_image. Temporary reviewer-generated 720 px boards were also opened before the repository boards became available.
review_method.config_and_caption: Read all four case configurations and separate captions. Re-read the corrected paired-effects caption and current README wording.
review_method.measurements: Independently read candidate PDF and SVG canvas dimensions, PNG dimensions/dpi, candidate PDF font sizes and embedded-font descriptors. Read baseline PDF dimensions/font sizes directly from baseline-revision Git blobs.
review_method.preservation: Compared all four source files with baseline-revision Git blobs. Compared plotted and summary/selection/participant-order tables as specified below. This checks preservation, not biological validity or statistical correctness.
review_method.comparison_identity: Baseline/candidate hashes match manifest.json; full hashes recorded per case.

annotated-inhibition.reading_task: Read selected pairwise growth-delay values first, with genome status and correctly aligned full-matrix marginal means as context.
visible_gain: The less saturated blue marginal bars and gray-teal metadata strips stop competing with the coral matrix.
The matrix shows clearer warm-value variation without adding a frame or changing its value range.
Required strain labels, full-data mean axes and the continuous guide remain visible at 720 px.
tradeoffs: Moderate matrix values still occupy a relatively narrow band of pale colors.
The sequential scale supports ordered magnitude reading; it does not give zero or the 11 negative selected measurements a distinct signed hue.
The unoutlined light metadata key is less prominent than the old outlined key but remains associated with its label at the reviewed display size.

cell-atlas-dotplot.reading_task: Compare counts and within-depot shares for each subtype while reading the aligned pooled totals and source-derived group labels.
visible_gain: Removing broad alternate backgrounds and continuous depot rules lets the quantitative dots stand out on white.
Normal-weight headers, a narrower group strip and an unframed color guide reduce the weight of decoding aids.
The darker low endpoint slightly improves small positive dot contrast without changing their quantitative area.
tradeoffs: Group and row lookup depend more on preserved gaps, narrow strips and pale separators than on shaded bands.
Several extremely rare positive dots are still difficult to distinguish at 720 px; stronger color has not made every point separately legible.
The three guide types remain necessary but still occupy a substantial bottom band; no guide was removed or size key shrunk.

paired-effects.reading_task: Compare supplied cohort estimates and asymmetric 95% interval endpoints against zero within each source term and domain.
visible_gain: The coordinated blue/coral pair and larger constant estimate circles distinguish the primary data from the pale zero guide.
Removing full-height nonzero grids and endpoint caps reduces repetitive lines while retaining the supplied interval endpoints.
The dashed zero guide remains locatable and interval crossings are readable at 720 px.
tradeoffs: The lighter zero guide is less immediate than the former solid line and needs contrast checking in a print proof.
Removing nonzero grid lines reduces exact interpolation support; ticks and interval endpoints remain, and the source table is required for exact numeric lookup.
Normal-weight gray domain headings are less emphatic, with grouping carried by their separate positions and gaps.

paired-myeloid-remodeling.reading_task: Compare cohort median changes, participant variation and the descriptive percentage strictly below zero across 16 subtypes.
visible_gain: The coordinated blue/coral summary layers are more balanced than the former blue/amber combination.
The dashed zero guide and thinner separators reduce the strength of secondary structure.
The median/IQR summaries, subtype order, cohort labels and aligned percentages remain readable at 720 px.
tradeoffs: Lower participant alpha makes raw observations lighter than the baseline; this favors summary comparison over individual-value inspection.
Overlapping marks are still possible; retaining and plotting all 832 observations does not establish that every point is separately visible.
This matched comparison uses distribution-ledger panels at equal width. The README improvement from replacing the old three-up board with one full panel is a separate presentation change.

findings.evidence: Common moderate values remain close in the pale range, and a sequential ramp does not isolate negative values or zero by hue.
findings.requirement: Preserve the adopted linear range and source values; do not claim that cosmetic recoloring solved signed-value decoding.
findings.action: Retain the current disclosed linear scale. For a future sign-focused reading task, compare a separately adopted zero-centered candidate rather than silently changing normalization.

findings.evidence: At 720 px, several tiny positive depot/subtype dots remain difficult to separate from white even with the stronger low endpoint.
findings.requirement: Quantitative point area must remain exact; observation presence must not be equated with easy visual lookup.
findings.action: Keep this limitation explicit. If individual rare-coordinate lookup becomes required, adopt a separate presence cue or larger panel instead of imposing a hidden minimum quantitative area.

findings.location: paired-effects zero guide and domain labels
findings.evidence: The pale dashed zero guide and normal-weight domain labels are visible on the inspected images but less prominent than the baseline.
findings.requirement: The zero reference and source groups must remain readable at final use size.
findings.action: Check their contrast in the final print proof; adjust those specific guide/text roles if that proof loses them, without restoring a full heavy grid.

findings.evidence: Raw participant points are lighter than the baseline and some overlap is possible at the reviewed display size.
findings.requirement: All observations must remain plotted; do not claim every mark is separately discernible from a downsampled preview.
findings.action: Use plotted/retained wording and preserve the source tables. Favor the earlier alpha or a different adopted layout when precise individual-value lookup is the primary task.

resolved_findings.initial_evidence: The initially read caption still described amber Replication marks and endpoint caps while the current panel uses coral and uncapped segments.
resolved_findings.resolution: The implementing Agent corrected the caption; the reviewer re-read coral, uncapped horizontal segments and dashed zero guide wording.

resolved_findings.initial_evidence: The initially read wording said all 832 paired changes remain visible, which overclaimed individual visibility at 720 px.
resolved_findings.resolution: The implementing Agent changed the wording to all 832 paired changes are plotted; the reviewer re-read it.

independent_preservation_checks.interpretation: These comparisons demonstrate unchanged saved data/derived rows for the reviewed refinement. They are not independent recalculation of statistics or certification of the source study.

independent_export_checks.evidence: All four baseline and candidate PDF canvases match. All PDF text inspected is 8 pt. Candidate SVG canvases match expected dimensions; PNG raster canvases equal baseline; candidate Arial font descriptors are embedded.
independent_export_checks.numeric_rounding_note: PNG metadata reports approximately 299.9994 dpi. Some 180 mm rasters are 2125 px; this retained one-pixel rendering rounding is not a changed physical PDF/SVG canvas.

external_checks_inspected.scope: Read implementation-produced source/artist, denominator, geometry and export records. Their reported numeric checks were not independently rerun or treated as aesthetic proof.

limitations: A qualitative review of these four fixed examples does not establish arbitrary-data generalization, publication acceptance or a universal preferred palette.
This is not a WorkBuddy or domestic-model benchmark, a novice-user trial, or a use-versus-no-use EasyViz experiment.
Source/table preservation and export inspection do not certify statistics, biological interpretation or original source quality.
Full-panel PNG inspection and downsampled 720 px review do not replace an actual physical print proof, a color-vision-deficiency test, or a browser screenshot of GitHub.
Candidate PDFs were measured for dimensions, fonts and embedding; this reviewer did not visually rasterize all four PDFs. SVG appearance across external editors was not tested.
Candidate preferences concern the declared reading tasks; lighter guides and raw marks have explicit costs and should not become unconditional rules.

user_outcome.reason: User found the muted/light styles less refined, foggy, and insufficiently informed by the supplied literature. Technical checks did not establish aesthetic improvement.
